title: The hint lines appear only after Save settings
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use an organization in which the setting was switched on before, so no turn-on window opens.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings > Work Orders.
  2. Switch the "Internal Work Orders" toggle on.
  3. Click Save settings.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The toggle is off and no hint lines show.

Step 2:

  • The toggle shows on, and the hint lines are not shown yet.

Step 3:

  • The hint lines show under the description.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R3: “While the toggle is on, two hint lines sit under the description, each with an info icon: "Manage categories in Internal Work Orders (Administration > Service). Their expense accounts are set on each category." where Internal Work Orders is a link to the categories page (S1-R13), and "Map their expense accounts in Integrations > QuickBooks." with the QuickBooks mark, where QuickBooks is a link (shown only when QuickBooks is connected at any location; for AccountingHub the hint names Accounting > Account Mappings; with both, the hint names both; with neither, the second line is omitted). The earlier hint about flagging the company is dropped; the flag is explained on Edit Customer.”

From: "Internal Work Orders technical implementation plan", 2026-10-28, last updated 2026-11-10 (revision 5, built on PRD v1.0), sources/TECH-PLAN-Internal-Work-Orders-upload-2026-11-12.md, read 12 Nov 2026

  • Tech plan line 3762 (TP-554): “**E-9 Settings hints:** from the saved value, not the draft.”
